obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary action buttons on light surfaces, body text, headlines, card borders — the universal ink of the system

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas on light sections, card surfaces, text on dark backgrounds, button text on filled buttons

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Dark section backgrounds — the only large chromatic surface, used for narrative bands between editorial spreads

bone.$description: Bone — Card surfaces and hairline borders on light sections — the warm off-white that prevents starkness

sandstone.$description: Sandstone — Warm card surface tint, section backgrounds in cream/peach areas — desert-hour warmth

ash-blush.$description: Ash Blush — Soft warm card surface, secondary peach accent on portrait cards

stone.$description: Stone — Muted neutral footer and section dividers — warm mid-gray grounding color

iron.$description: Iron — Button and link background tint, card surface for outlined controls

pewter.$description: Pewter — Disabled or tertiary button fills, secondary surface fills

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Near-black for dark button fills on light surfaces where pure black feels too harsh

dusty-sky.$description: Dusty Sky — Soft blue pastel — feature card background, decorative portrait card tint

mist-mint.$description: Mist Mint — Pale mint-teal pastel — feature card background variant

wisteria.$description: Wisteria — Lavender pastel — feature card background variant

desert-clay.$description: Desert Clay — Warm peach/tan pastel — feature card background variant, ties to hero photography palette

slate-teal.$description: Slate Teal — Muted blue-teal for feature tag pills on dark sections, badge backgrounds — the only repetitive chromatic UI element

saddle-brown.$description: Saddle Brown — Warm brown for badge borders and occasional accent text — echoes the terrain photography

es-allianz.$description: Primary typeface for all UI text — a high-contrast didone-influenced serif used at dramatic display sizes (74–152px) for headlines, and at body sizes (16–19px) for running text. The tight letter-spacing (-0.045em at display, -0.02em at body) tightens the serifs into a modern editorial stance. Weight 400 carries most copy; 700 for hero impact; 500 for navigation and subheadings. This serif does the heavy lifting that a sans-serif system would spread across three families.
